### Day 290: Acts 27:9–12
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-290-acts-27-912.html
Passage: Acts 27:9-12
Points:
- Paul demonstrated practical, experienced judgment alongside spiritual wisdom by warning the crew that continuing the voyage would bring disaster.
- The ship's pilot and owner prioritized financial profit over safety, ignoring Paul's caution and sailing directly into danger.
- Paul and his companions were plunged into peril not because of their own rebellion, but because of someone else's poor decision.
- Suffering caused by the bad judgment of others is especially hard to face because it readily tempts us to bitterness and blame.
- Rather than focusing on human blame, believers caught in storms caused by others should keep their eyes fixed on God's greater purpose.
